cues.name: stone
cues.development: D minor/add9. The D-A-Bb-F motif, with an answering voice below the struck bars.

cues.name: memory
cues.development: Bb major9/#11. The same outline returns; its last note opens into E instead of F.

cues.name: someone
cues.development: D major9/F#. Metal falls silent. A close human-scale voice changes Bb to B and F to F#. The building remembers warmth.

cues.name: upstairs
cues.development: A7sus/b9 to A7. G-E-C# descends as the final A pickup reaches back to the opening D. Tails continue around the loop.
